usedFor: Shopify raises store events, and Callingly receives a call request through “Call Lead” for a shopper.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Call Lead” in Callingly
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left a checkout with a phone number can reach the first free team member.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Call Lead” in Callingly rings after a scheduled check.
